applies_to: YORK YT water-cooled centrifugal chillers with OptiView controls, fitted with the SC-EQ communication card (VSD, solid-state or electro-mechanical starters).
summary: YORK by Johnson Controls YT centrifugal chillers reach a BAS through the SC-EQ communication card, which serves BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU / N2) and replaced the older E-Link gateway. The SC-EQ list has four remote commands (start/stop, leaving chilled liquid setpoint, current limit, VSD fixed-speed select), temperatures, pressures, starter and VSD values, and multistate operation, safety, cycling and warning codes with matching analog copies.
notes: Access is inferred: the sheet has no read/write column. The remote block (AV 1-2, BV 1, BV 3) is treated as commandable and MV 65001 as writable; everything else as read-only.

Some instances depend on the starter: AV 13-15, AV 35, AV 36, AV 121 and AV 122 carry VSD values on VSD units and solid-state or electro-mechanical starter values otherwise. These are merged into one row each.

Status-code MVs (operation, fault, warning, modified run, start inhibit, internal fault) are the printed code + 1, as the doc's status code tables say; the AV copies (AV 401 and up) carry the raw code. MVs with their own enum in the points table (Units, control sources) are shown as printed, from 0; BACnet multistate values start at 1, so the card may report the printed number + 1. Confirm by discovery.
Units shown are the IP units; with MV 65001 set to SI the card reports °C, kPa and so on.
Operating hours and kWh are also split into low/offset pairs (value = offset x 10,000 + low).

integration.summary: Start and stop it with BV 1 and write the leaving chilled liquid setpoint (AV 1) and current limit (AV 2). Read MV 1 for the operating state, BV 5 for motor run, the leaving water temperature and % FLA, and MV 2/MV 3 for safety and cycling shutdowns.

minimum_points.name: UNIT CONTROL SOURCE
minimum_points.why: Control source; ISN (BAS) for BMS control

integration.enable: BV 1 REM START STOP CMD (0 = Stop, 1 = Start) is the BAS start/stop, and AV 1-2 are the remote setpoints. MV 5 Unit Control Source shows Local, ISN (BAS), Analog, Digital or Modem; check it reads ISN (BAS). The points list has no write-enable point and doesn't say how the source is chosen at the chiller panel.
setup: The BAS connects to the SC-EQ J12 port (RS-485: +, -, COM/REF, SHLD). The card detects BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU or N2 and the baud rate by itself; allow up to 120 seconds after power-up.
The MAC address (1-127) is set on DIP switch SW1 (switch 8 unused). Cycle the card's power after changing it.

The device instance defaults to 5000 + the MAC address (MAC 6 gives 5006). To use another number, set Device Instance Mode to Manual and enter the instance with the SC-AP / MAP tool, or write BV 65000 (mode) and AV 65000 (instance ID).
MV 65001 Units sets whether the BAS sees IP or SI values, independent of the chiller display; set it to match the chiller.
gotchas: The remote (commandable) setpoints read as unreliable until the BAS writes them the first time.
The SC-EQ only exposes the points that apply to the chiller it detects; if it replaces an E-Link, re-discover the device so old non-applicable points don't sit offline.
Starter type changes what several AVs mean (see notes); check the starter before trending AV 13-15, 35 and 36.
